author: Atlas

findings.detail: gameplan_trade_snapshot and stock_trader/state already use broker-reported account-wide pending cash reservations when calculating available literal cash.

gameplan_cash_ledger derives projected symbols and events from its supplied trade_rows. Its snapshot accounts for reported gross exposure and pending reserves, but the event projection does not join a second frozen publication.
The independent session and cycle locks, entry-slot claims and HorizonLedger SQLite path are rooted in the local datastore.

Local serialization does not serialize another PC. Independent workers can both observe capacity before a new commitment becomes broker-visible; different symbol selections do not partition the shared budget or total exposure.

limitations: The verified source facts apply to Atlas committed source 99532621db0d42dfe8c655300cc93abda81240d5. Scout current working bytes and implementation choices have not been inspected.
No patch, immutable tested implementation candidate, source-completion record or deployment receipt exists for this design finding.
This factual relay does not authorize peer source changes, provider/broker calls, orders, training, funds movements, runtime actions, schedules or ownership changes.
open_owner_decisions: Agree on the combined source-receipt and planning interface, source-freezing rules and deterministic ordering before competing implementations are completed.
Identify the proposed single reservation/execution owner and its unavailable-owner behavior for human review; no owner change is granted by this notice.
Return the proposed interface/ownership decision and exact reviewed source revision, tests and limitations through the existing channel when available.
producer: Loops Overnight Gameplan read-only design review; independently checked by Atlas courier
proposed_interface: Retain both independently frozen forecast/evaluation publications. Bind both exact source receipts to the same next-session action_date and verify complete universe coverage before combining their planning inputs.

Build one joint chronological planning ledger from one starting budget, with global purchase ordering, all-account pending commitments and ownership evidence from both producers. Derive each producer eleven-symbol view from that same plan.

Preserve per-symbol/horizon lots, immutable original forecast identities and the approved fallback cap. Keep each accuracy review tied to its original forecast; a combined review can aggregate the scored outcomes without rebuilding past forecasts.
Live spending requires one durable reservation/execution authority and actual broker evidence for spendable cash. Forecast sale proceeds remain conditional planning entries.

Use immutable Git artifacts for frozen source exchange. Git notices and mutable database copies do not implement a real-time cash lock. Keep live budget, account identifiers, balances, holdings and bindings out of coordination notices.
runtime_implications: Design reference only. No application source, local symbol/profile/account state, runtime, trade, training, schedule or ownership was changed. No projected proceeds are asserted to be live spendable cash.
scope: Common planning and reservation design reference for the two existing producers. Keep each existing eleven-symbol universe and forecast/evaluation identities; proposed combined planning coverage is their twenty-two-symbol union.
summary: Atlas joint-Gameplan design finding for existing owner review: combine the two frozen symbol publications into one cash/exposure plan; define one live reservation authority. Proposal only; no implementation.
